newsitem.title: NORWAY: Enron to be market maker on Nordic power bourse.
newsitem.headline: Enron to be market maker on Nordic power bourse.

text.p: Enron Nordic Energy said on Wednesday it would begin acting as market maker for all based load electricity trades on the Nord Pool power futures market.
Enron Nordic Energy is a branch of Enron Capital & Trade Resources International, headquartered in Houston, and has a base in Oslo for all trading and marketing activities in the Nordic region.
Nord Pool is the world's first power bourse for both producers and consumers for the free trade of electricity across borders in the Nordic countries of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

"We are pleased to serve in this capacity, which reflects our commitment to the Nordic markets and our active involvement both in the Nord Pool and bilateral transactions," Mark Frevert, president at Enron Europe, was quoted in a statement as saying.
"We believe the Nordic model for the trading of electricity is one of the most effective and efficient models worldwide," he said.
